rows.name_as_written: Round 10 release of the FinnGen consortium
rows.quote: The summary-level GWAS data for POAG were extracted from the latest Round 10 release of the FinnGen consortium (8,530 cases and 391,275 controls) (https://r10.finngen.fi/) and the UK Biobank (4,737 cases and 458,196 controls), respectively.
rows.coder_note: Sentence states the Round 10 release of the FinnGen consortium with the r10.finngen.fi address.

Reread all three passages. The UK Biobank outcome GWAS is given with case and control counts and the general cohort citation (reference B40), which is no dictionary row's source; no pipeline, release, accession or GWAS citation is stated. The other references in the row's passages concern the pQTL data, not the outcome GWAS.

rows.quote: DeCODE reported the pQTL data of 4,907 plasma proteins measured in 35,559 Icelanders with SomaScan version four and UKB-PPP presented comprehensive pQTL mapping of 2,923 proteins measured from 54,219 UK Biobank participants using the Olink platform (Ferkingstad et al., 2021; Sun et al., 2023).
rows.coder_note: Sentence gives 35,559 Icelanders with SomaScan version four and 4,907 proteins, cited to Ferkingstad et al., 2021: the exact sample size, platform and year of one row.

Reread all three passages. The dataset is described as 2,923 proteins from 54,219 participants on the Olink platform and cited to Sun et al., 2023. That sample size is no candidate row's, the cited paper is the source of several candidate rows, and no sentence names a cohort subset, so no single release is identified.
